prerequisites: None. Competencies taught in the Algorithms and Data Structures module are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: The students can describe the most important models for information retrieval.
can explain the architecture of IR systems.
can describe the optimization of queries in IR.
can apply IR in the area of Web and Multimedia.
can apply scientific working methods (identifying, formulating, solving problems, training abstraction skills).
are able to speak freely about scientific content, both before an audience and in a discussion.

assessment_methods.method: Oral presentation of solutions to at least two exercise assignments

assessment_rules: To acquire 6 LP, students must achieve at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise assignments and orally present the solution of at least two of the exercise assignments. The examination performance is either an oral examination (individual examination) or a written examination. Grading is based on a scale of 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the M.Sc. Data Science degree program.
bibliography: Manning, Raghavan, Schütze: Introduction to Information Retrieval, Cambridge University Press
Baeza-Yates, Ribeiro-Neto: Modern Information Retrieval, Addison Wesley
Ferber: Information Retrieval-Suchmodelle und Data-Mining-Verfahren für Textsammlungen und das Web, dpunkt Verlag
Henrich: Information Retrieval - Grundlagen, Modelle und Anwendungen
